name: urlscan.io
tagline: Live website scanning and sandboxing for phishing and malware investigation.
description: urlscan.io is a public API for submitting URLs to a browser sandbox, capturing screenshots, network activity, DOM, and threat indicators. Used by security teams and researchers to investigate phishing, malware, and suspicious sites with search and result APIs.

auth.details: API key via API-Key header (or ?apiKey= query param on some endpoints); self-serve signup at urlscan.io. Public search may work unauthenticated with lower limits.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan daily quotas (via UI or API): 50 private scans, 1,000 unlisted scans, 5,000 public scans, 1,000 search requests, 1,000 result requests; per-minute/hour caps also apply (see /user/quotas/).
pricing.paid_plans: API Only Automate from $5,000/yr; Professional $1,250/mo ($12,500/yr); Enterprise $2,500/mo ($25,000/yr); Ultimate $5,000/mo ($50,000/yr). 30-day commercial trials available.

rate_limits: Per-action quotas with separate minute, hour, and day windows; HTTP 429 when exceeded; exact limits via GET https://urlscan.io/user/quotas/ (or /api/v1/quotas) and X-Rate-Limit-* response headers. Fixed-window resets at full minute/hour and midnight UTC; only HTTP 200 counts.
use_cases: submit a URL for sandbox scanning and get a result UUID
fetch scan result JSON including network requests and screenshots
search historical urlscan results for a domain or hash
check if a URL has been scanned before for phishing investigation
